statement: ∀ (h : ℝ), 0 ≤ h → ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 ((m : ℝ) * h), ∃ i : ℕ, i < m ∧ t ∈ Set.Icc ((i : ℝ) * h) (((i : ℝ) + 1) * h)
proof:
intro h hh m
induction m with
| zero =>
  intro t ht
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, Set.mem_Icc] at ht
  -- zero-length endpoint is handled separately below
  sorry
| succ m ih =>
  intro t ht
  by_cases hm : t ≤ (m : ℝ) * h
  · obtain ⟨i, hi, hit⟩ := ih t ⟨ht.1, hm⟩
    exact ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi, hit⟩
  · exact ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_self m, le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hm), by simpa using ht.2⟩
